hotPlans.sql:
SELECT
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.due_date < $2::date)::text AS overdue,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.due_date >= $2::date AND c.due_date <= ($2::date + 7))::text AS due_soon
       FROM cards c
       JOIN columns col ON col.id = c.column_id AND col.deleted_at IS NULL
       WHERE c.board_id = $1 AND c.state = '<literal>' AND c.due_date IS NOT NULL AND col.category <> '<literal>'

SELECT 
       c.id, c.board_id, c.column_id, c.title, c.priority,
       to_char(c.due_date, '<literal>') AS due_date, c.position::TEXT,
       c.version, c.created_at, c.updated_at,
       p.name AS project_name, b.name AS board_name, col.name AS column_title,
       p.key_prefix || '<literal>' || c.card_number::text AS card_key
     FROM cards c
     JOIN card_assignees ca ON ca.card_id = c.id
     JOIN projects p ON c.project_id = p.id
     JOIN boards b ON c.board_id = b.id
     JOIN columns col ON c.column_id = col.id AND col.deleted_at IS NULL
     JOIN workspaces w ON p.workspace_id = w.id
     LEFT JOIN project_memberships pm ON pm.project_id = p.id AND pm.user_id = $1 AND pm.status = '<literal>'
     WHERE c.state = '<literal>' AND p.archived = FALSE AND b.archived = FALSE AND ca.user_id = $1 AND c.project_id = $2 AND (w.owner_id = $1 OR pm.id IS NOT NULL) AND (w.owner_id = $1 OR EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM board_grants bg WHERE bg.board_id = c.board_id
         AND bg.project_id = c.project_id AND bg.user_id = $1)) AND c.board_id = ANY($3::text[])
     ORDER BY c.due_date ASC NULLS LAST, c.id ASC
     LIMIT $4

SELECT 
      (SELECT COUNT(*)::INT FROM cards counted
       JOIN projects cp ON cp.id = counted.project_id
       JOIN workspaces cw ON cw.id = cp.workspace_id
       WHERE counted.project_id = $1 AND counted.state = '<literal>'
         AND (cw.owner_id = $2 OR EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM project_memberships pm JOIN board_grants bg
             ON bg.project_id = pm.project_id AND bg.user_id = pm.user_id
           WHERE pm.project_id = counted.project_id AND pm.user_id = $2
             AND pm.status = '<literal>' AND bg.board_id = counted.board_id))
         AND counted.board_id = ANY($3::text[])) AS active_count,
      COUNT(*)::INT AS matching_count
    FROM cards c
    JOIN columns col ON col.id = c.column_id AND col.deleted_at IS NULL
    JOIN projects p ON p.id = c.project_id
    JOIN workspaces w ON w.id = p.workspace_id
    WHERE c.project_id = $1 AND c.state = '<literal>' AND (w.owner_id = $2 OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM project_memberships pm JOIN board_grants bg
      ON bg.project_id = pm.project_id AND bg.user_id = pm.user_id
    WHERE pm.project_id = c.project_id AND pm.user_id = $2
      AND pm.status = '<literal>' AND bg.board_id = c.board_id)) AND c.board_id = ANY($3::text[]) AND (c.title ILIKE $4 OR c.description ILIKE $4) AND c.due_date IS NULL

Plans.Filter: ((due_date IS NULL) AND ((title ~~* '<literal>'::text) OR (description ~~* '<literal>'::text)) AND (board_id = ANY ('<literal>'::text[])))
